item.title: ‘DISASTROUS’: NO HIDING PLACE FOR NANCY
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY’S Celtic career is on the line – after just over two weeks in the job. The under-fire manager, who has seen the champions lose his four games in charge, MUST guide the team to a win over Aberdeen at Parkhead tomorrow afternoon – or face the dire consequences. item.title: ‘I’M HAPPY,’ AT LAST NANCY CAN SMILE
